# shipped-capabilities.txt
#
# Manifest for check-claim-backing.sh. One row per infrastructure/capability
# claim that published copy might assert. Fields are separated by " ::: "
# (not "|" — the regex column needs "|" for alternation, so it can't also
# be the field separator).
#
#   shipped ::: phrase-regex (grep -Ei) ::: note
#
# shipped=no rows are claims we are NOT allowed to assert as present-tense
# fact yet. If any of these phrases appear in a published page, the check
# fails — flip the row to "yes" (with a note citing what shipped) once the
# capability is real, never edit the copy around a "no" row to route past it.
#
# shipped=yes rows are informational only (not currently enforced as
# "must appear somewhere") — kept here so the manifest is the one place
# that says what's actually real, not scattered across memory/BACKLOG.md.
#
# Update this file in the same PR that ships the capability it unblocks.

no ::: public (notary|transparency) (log|entry|record|ledger)|publicly[- ]verifiable ledger|published to a public (notary|transparency) ::: BL-ENG-009 unbuilt; VISION Moat§2 PARKED-NOT-CUT. Direct cause of BL-ENG-149. Widened 2026-08-11 after "public notary log" regex missed "public notary entry" — same claim, different noun, found by a plain grep for "notary" the phrase-list checker didn't.
no ::: SOC ?2 (compliant|certified|report available|Type I complete) ::: EntPerMaSys clock running, not complete
no ::: ISO ?27001 (compliant|certified) ::: ISMS docs in progress, not certified
yes ::: Ed25519 sign(ed|ature)|deterministic config_hash|verify:? ?PASS|hash: VALID ::: juro-verify v1.2.0 shipped 2026-07-21 (verify:PASS proven live)
yes ::: non-custodial ::: Axiom 4 — architectural, always true
